text:
Typed decisions from frozen-model option logits

Usage: openjev [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  decide     Score one or more questions against the same state and options
  noul       Score the fixed yes/no Noul primitive
  score      Score ordered finite numeric levels
  ask        Score one complete Decision JSON object
  run        Score Decision JSONL in input order
  models     Inspect or populate the verified model cache
  eval       Evaluate an embedded authored or perturbation fixture
  bench      Benchmark direct and requested-shared execution
  calibrate  Fit temperature calibration (implemented in M7)
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --model <MODEL>
          
      --model-sha256 <MODEL_SHA256>
          
      --template-profile <TEMPLATE_PROFILE>
          
      --cache-dir <CACHE_DIR>
          
      --offline
          
      --device <DEVICE>
          [possible values: cpu, metal, cuda]
      --gpu-layers <GPU_LAYERS>
          
      --threads <THREADS>
          
      --n-ctx <N_CTX>
          
      --max-tokens <MAX_TOKENS>
          
      --max-context-tokens <MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS>
          
      --n-batch <N_BATCH>
          
      --n-ubatch <N_UBATCH>
          
      --max-sequences <MAX_SEQUENCES>
          
      --require-shared
          
      --permute <PERMUTE>
          
      --seed <SEED>
          
      --temperature <TEMPERATURE>
          
      --calibration <CALIBRATION>
          
      --confidence
          
      --compact
          Emit the compact decision projection (decide/noul/score/ask/run only)
      --pretty
          
      --quiet
          
      --serve
          Run the resident Jev-compatible HTTP service instead of a CLI command
      --host <HOST>
          HTTP bind address (valid only with --serve)
      --port <PORT>
          HTTP bind port (valid only with --serve)
      --request-timeout-secs <REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECS>
          Whole-request deadline in seconds (valid only with --serve)
      --api-key-env <API_KEY_ENV>
          Environment variable containing the bearer secret (valid only with --serve)
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version

Examples:
  printf 'ticket body' | openjev --model qwen3-0.6b decide --question 'Which queue?' --option 'Account access' --option Billing
  printf '%s\n' '{"id":"d1","state":"ticket","question":"Which queue?","options":[{"id":"access","description":"Account access"},{"id":"billing","description":"Billing"}]}' | openjev --model qwen3-0.6b ask
  printf '%s\n' '{"id":"d1","state":"ticket","question":"Which queue?","options":[{"id":"access","description":"Account access"},{"id":"billing","description":"Billing"}]}' | openjev --model qwen3-0.6b run
  openjev models list
  openjev --serve --offline --model qwen3-0.6b --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080

State text is never trimmed or guessed as JSON. Use --state-json or
--state-json-file for structured state. stdout is JSON/JSONL only.
--compact applies only to decide, noul, score, ask, and run.
--serve is an alternative to a command and keeps one verified model resident.
